title: Find the distinct elements present in atoms that are part of double-bonded
question: Find the distinct elements present in atoms that are part of double-bonded carcinogenic molecules and correspond to the 4th atom (by ID suffix) of their respective molecules.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T1."XCL_003"
FROM atom AS T1
INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1."XCL_002" = T2."XCL_010"
INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2."XCL_010" = T3."XCL_005"
WHERE T3."XCL_006" = '='
  AND T2."XCL_011" = '+'
  AND SUBSTRING(T1."XCL_001", -1) = '4'
